title: Production Groundwater Coupling Runtime Gap Decomposition and Implementation Order
critical_scope_boundaries: F-GC07 is research-harness temporal/coupling characterization only and does not admit a production coupler
F-SI28 is a solver-layer native-qbot sensitivity primitive only; transaction result transport, whole-window derivative composition and MODFLOW sign transformation remain explicitly unqualified there
F-GC14 only transports externally validated application-accuracy policy into the canonical runtime contract; it does not implement coupling orchestration
H_app and A_temporal remain externally governed and may not be invented by F-GC15
qualification_goal: Produce a machine-checkable, evidence-bound catalog of the remaining production groundwater-coupling runtime capabilities, their dependency order, their admission blockers and architecture-invariant obligations. A green F-GC15 means the gap decomposition is qualified, not that production coupling exists.
hard_nonclaims: no production SWAP-MODFLOW coupling is admitted
no coupling window algorithm is added to production source
no universal predictor-corrector threshold is selected
no whole-window response tangent is qualified
no numeric H_app or A_temporal is selected
